title: Home Rail Turns Your AI Chats Into Repeatable Workflows
description:
You know that feeling when you explain the same task to your AI agent for the tenth time and it still forgets? yeah 😅

Someone just dropped a thing called Home Rail on GitHub and it kinda fixes that. Basicaly it's a runtime that turns your normal conversation with an agent into a repeatable workflow. You build a DAG pipeline once, using your own voice, and after that it just runs itself.

The part I liked: it goes step by step, logs everything, and if it crash somewhere it restart from the exact point it left off, not from zero. 🔥

And the whole thing run on your own hardware. No cloud no data leaving your machine, everything stays under your control ✨ which honestly is rare these days.

If you wanna look it up its under xiaotianfotos homerail on github

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
